title: Money & currency
body:
Japan runs on the yen (¥); at research time {{fact:usd-jpy-approx-158}}. Card rates and airport-counter cash rates both run a few percent worse than this mid-market figure — check again close to departure, since this rate moves week to week.

7-Eleven ATMs (Seven Bank) are the most reliable way to pull cash on a foreign card — nearly every store has one, most open 00:05–23:50 daily. The per-withdrawal limit is ¥100,000 for a foreign-issued card (¥30,000 on a magnetic-stripe card); fees vary by card network on top of whatever your home bank charges.

Japan's tax-free shopping system changes on Nov 1, 2026 — just before this trip — from an instant discount at the register to a refund claimed at departure instead. Budget the full sticker price at checkout on this trip and claim the refund at the airport, not the old on-the-spot discount.
